scope: Atomic cash/share reservations and repriced operator approval

result: No open concrete finding remains in the reviewed scope. Three reported issues were fixed by the backend owner and rechecked. Independent accounting and worker scenarios passed.

findings.title: Cancelled failing task was stranded as queued
reproduction: Fake annotate calls cancel_task on the running task, then raises RuntimeError.
Original exception branch requeued status=queued with cancel_requested=1; next run selected no task.
findings.fix_evidence: Exception path now cancels before retry; queued cancellation cleanup also runs. Current fake-provider cancellation case yields cancelled and cancelled remaining steps.

findings.title: Expired agent lease was displayed as working
reproduction: Persist running task/first step with dead lease owner and expired lease.
Original snapshot reported agent working while health had lease_active=false.
findings.fix_evidence: Snapshot now requires matching unexpired task/global worker lease. Current expired-owner case reports coordinator as not working.

findings.title: Annotation label denied tools that were actually available
reproduction: Configured explicit brief/note can call registered read-only operational inspection tools.
findings.fix_evidence: Current wording distinguishes read-only inspection from trade-execution authority.

checks.evidence: Repeated funding identity credits once; mismatched amount rejects.
Buy 0.333333 at 10.005; sell 0.111111 and 0.222222 at 15.005. Final cash 101.67, realized P&L 1.67, zero residual quantity/cost basis; accountant reconstruction passes.
Two concurrent $60 intents against $100 permit only one reservation.
Two concurrent four-share sell intents against six shares permit only one reservation.
Four simultaneous approvals produce one sale fill and one quantity/cash change.
Repriced approval rejects when other reservations leave insufficient cash; no fill or holdings mutation. Cancelling competing order releases reservation; explicit approval fills at current quote.
Older and future quotes reject without replacing the quote; stale quote cannot create an intent.
Replacement worker resumes after committed accountant step; six-step cycle finishes with one accountant snapshot.
Repeated active-cycle request returns same ID; recovered cycle preserves manual pending intention, creates no orders/fills/strategies and invokes no configured model.
Cancel while annotation runs, then fail annotation: task/remaining steps become cancelled, not an unselectable queued task.
Blocked former owner loses leases; replacement completes task. Former response commits no annotation or handoff.
Running step with expired task/global lease is no longer reported working.
Targeted fake-provider test confirms actual registered read-only tool inspection and durable receipts. No external call made.
